title: Overdue Fee on a Past-Due Tailwise Plus Annual Tier — Calculation Sheet
content:
**Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus — the overdue fee collected to reinstate Tailwise Plus Annual or Tailwise Plus Premier Annual.**

**Fee.** The overdue fee is the membership fee of the paid tier held, collected in full: the membership fee of Tailwise Plus Annual or of Tailwise Plus Premier Annual, whichever the membership holds.

**Order of working.** Amounts applied to the overdue fee are applied in a fixed order: any change for the time spent past due applies to the membership fee first; a percentage rate then applies once to the fee so changed; flat dollar amounts are then subtracted from the result.

**Floor and rounding.** The overdue fee is never below zero and is rounded to the nearest cent as the last step.

| Paid tier held | Overdue fee before anything is applied |
|---|---|
| Tailwise Plus Annual | the Tailwise Plus Annual membership fee, $59.00 |
| Tailwise Plus Premier Annual | the Tailwise Plus Premier Annual membership fee, $119.00 |

**Worked case (hypothetical).** A past-due Tailwise Plus Annual membership with nothing applied to its fee: the overdue fee is the full Tailwise Plus Annual membership fee of $59.00.

**Rounding (hypothetical intermediate figures).** A fee worked through to $53.0904 is collected as $53.09; a figure below zero is collected as $0.00.
